title: Get room and rate details — structuredContent
description: The `structuredContent` of the `get_room_rate_details` MCP tool: one property's available room types and their rate plans for one stay, for the T-04 inline carousel (Figma `D_InLine_Light_T-04` 1630:43853) AND the full screen (617:51047 web, 617:51755 mobile) without a second call (PRD §2, §2.4). Follows PRD T-04 §6.1 in shape (`meta` + `rooms[]` + `rate_plans[]`) and names, checked against upstream `apartmentratedetails – V3` as MuleSoft's merged sample returns it (`propertyList[].apartments[].room0[]`). Departures from the PRD are listed in room-rate-details/README.md. 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-21).

price.description: An amount in `meta.currency`, TAXES AND FEES INCLUDED, as a number (not the upstream string). The widget formats it.

imagePath.description: An upstream image path (or absolute URL), resolved by the widget against `meta.asset_base_url`.

rate_plan_code.description: PRD `rate_plan_code` ← upstream `ratePlanCode`, e.g. "ZZFLEX". Sent to T-08 `create_booking` as `ratePlanCode` when the user books this rate.

description.description: ADDED ← upstream `ratePlanDescription`, plain text or CMS HTML verbatim (the widget reduces it to text), e.g. what the rate includes. The full-screen rate card's benefit lines. Optional.

per_night_rate.description: PRD `per_night_rate_pref_curr`: the average rate per night, taxes and fees included, in `meta.currency`. Upstream gives it before tax (`perNightRatePrefCurr`, `isTaxInclusive` false on 73 of 74 sampled rates) and the tax apart (`totalTaxPrefCurrency`), so MuleSoft adds them: (`totalStayRatePrefCurr` + `totalTaxPrefCurrency`) ÷ nights. The inline card's "Our lowest price" and the full-screen rate card.

total_stay_rate.description: PRD `total_stay_rate_pref_curr`: the whole stay, taxes and fees included, in `meta.currency` (`totalStayRatePrefCurr` + `totalTaxPrefCurrency`). The full-screen booking summary's total.

strikethrough_rate.description: PRD `strikethrough_rate_pref_curr` ← upstream `strikethroughRatePrefCurr`, per night, taxes included on the same basis as `per_night_rate`. Optional: omit when upstream is empty or not above `per_night_rate`.

save_percentage.description: PRD `save_percentage` ← upstream `savePercentage` ("15" → 15). Optional: omit when there is no strikethrough rate.

earn_asr_points.description: PRD `earn_asr_points` ← upstream `earnASRpoints` ("3995" → 3995) for the whole stay. The inline card's gold "Earn up to … Pts for this stay!" banner; 0 or absent shows the grey "ASR points are not available for this booking." one.

non_refundable.description: PRD `non_refundable` ← upstream `nonRefundable`. Optional; absent means refundable on the terms in `cancellation_description`.

cancellation_description.description: PRD `cancellation_description` ← upstream `cancellationDescription`, verbatim, e.g. "Cancel 24hrs prior to arrival by 1500hrs. …". Optional.

free_cancellation_until.description: ADDED, optional and RESERVED: the last moment the rate can be cancelled free, local to the property (Figma: "Free cancellation until 6:00 PM on 18 Sep 2026"). Upstream has only the `cancellation_description` sentence today; the card shows that sentence until this is sent.

is_app_exclusive.description: PRD "App exclusive rate" label (OQ-04) ← upstream `ratePlanChannel` = "MOBILE" ("WEB" otherwise). Optional. Only sent for rates that are bookable from the ChatGPT hand-off at all (README, 'Which rates').

includes_breakfast.description: ADDED, optional and RESERVED (Figma full-screen chip "Breakfast included"): upstream has no such flag, only rate names like "Best Flexible Rate with Breakfast". The chip is hidden until this is sent.

meta.description: PRD §6.1 `meta`: the resolved property and the stay that was actually searched, once per response. The values the search used, not the user's words: the widget passes them to T-08 `create_booking` unchanged.

property_name.description: PRD `meta.property_name`. The ENGLISH name (upstream `propertyName`): the header ("3 Rooms available at …") and the website link are built from it.

brand_code.description: ADDED, the same field as T-01 to T-03: the upstream `brand` slug verbatim, e.g. "ascott-the-residence". Picks the card's brand panel colour and builds the website link. PRD `brand_name` ("Ascott The Residence") is not used: the widget owns the brand names and logos.

country_code.description: ADDED, optional (as T-02 and T-03). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upstream `countryCode`. With `brand_code` and `property_name` the widget builds the full screen's "Open in discoverasr.com" link to the property's page; without it, the site's search.

asset_base_url.description: ADDED (as T-01 to T-03). Origin the widget resolves relative image paths against; default https://www.discoverasr.com.

checkin_date.description: PRD `meta.checkin_date`: the stay searched, after server defaults. T-08's `checkinDate`.

checkout_date.description: PRD `meta.checkout_date`. T-08's `checkoutDate`. The widget counts the nights from the two dates.

is_all_avail.description: PRD `is_all_avail` ← upstream `isAllAvail`: every requested room (`noOfRooms`) can be booked. Moved from the room to `meta` because only `room0` is listed (README, 'Several rooms'). Optional; absent means true. When false the widget says that not every requested room is available.

currency.description: PRD `meta.currency`: ISO 4217 code of EVERY price in the response, i.e. the input's `currencyCode` (or the property's currency when omitted). Upstream's `…PrefCurr` amounts are in it, but upstream does not name it, so MuleSoft fills it from the request.

voucher_code_valid.description: ADDED ← upstream `isCodeValid`. Sent only when the input had a `voucherCode`: whether upstream accepted it.

total_results.description: PRD `meta.total_results`: the length of `rooms`. 0 is a valid result (no room available for the stay, or none in the price range), not an error.

rooms.description: The room types available for the stay (upstream `room0`), in upstream `ranking` order. Only rooms with at least one bookable rate; empty when none.

room_code.description: ← upstream `apartmentType`, e.g. "0BRCT": unique within the property. NOT `apartmentCategoryCode` as PRD §6 says: that is a category ("Studio", "1 Bedroom") and repeats (three "1 Bedroom" room types at one sampled property). T-08's room identifier and T-07's room code.

room_category.description: ← upstream `apartmentCategoryCode`, e.g. "Studio", "1 Bedroom". Optional; for the model (e.g. "show me the one-bedrooms").

ranking.description: PRD `ranking` ← upstream `ranking`. `rooms` is already in this order. Optional.

description.description: PRD `room_narrative_description` (marked API GAP there) ← upstream `roomInformation`, which the sample does carry, plain text or CMS HTML verbatim. The full screen's room description. Optional.

bed_type.description: PRD `bed_type` ← upstream `bedType`, verbatim, e.g. "1 King-size bed or Twin Beds". Optional.

max_person_in_room.description: PRD `max_person_in_room` ← upstream `maxPersonInRoom`, verbatim English, e.g. "Max 2 pax (3rd pax chargeable)". Optional.

max_occupancy.description: ADDED ← upstream `maxOccupancy` ("3" → 3). Optional. With it the widget writes the capacity in the user's language ("2 pax") instead of the English sentence.

size_sqm.description: PRD `dimension` ← upstream `dimension` ("48" → 48), in square metres (to be confirmed by MuleSoft: upstream sends a bare number). The widget writes "48 sqm / 517 sqft". Optional.

units_remaining.description: PRD `no_of_unit_remaining` ← upstream `noOfUnitRemaining`. Optional; not shown in Figma today.

thumbnail_url.description: ADDED ← upstream `thumbnailImage` (square). The full screen's room list. Optional.

banner_image_url.description: PRD `banner_image_url` ← upstream `bannerImageMobile`. The first photo when `gallery` is empty. Optional.

floor_plan_url.description: ADDED ← upstream `floorPlanPath`. Optional; not shown in Figma today.

gallery.description: PRD `gallery[]` ← upstream `imageGalleryItems[]` with `galleryType` "image": `galleryImage` (the resized one) else `path`. The inline photo carousel and the full screen's gallery. Optional.

title.description: Upstream `title`; omit when empty (it is in the sample). Used as the image's alt text.

amenity_groups.description: PRD `amenity_groups[]` ← upstream `amenityGroups[]`. The full screen's Amenity Details tab. Groups with no amenities, and the unnamed group upstream sends with a null amenity, are left out. Optional.

group.description: ← upstream `refAmenityGroup` verbatim: "bedroom", "bathroom", "livingroom", "kitchen", "balcony", "others" in the sample. The widget titles and icons the groups it knows and shows the rest under a generic title.

items.description: ← upstream `amenities[].description`, e.g. "Coffee machine". PRD `charge` and `facility_icon` are left out: every sampled charge is "free" and the widget draws its own group icons.

tag.description: ADDED, optional and RESERVED: the chip on the inline photo (Figma 1630:43853: "Great for couples"), text only. No upstream field today (PRD OQ-03); hidden until sent.

features.description: ADDED, optional and RESERVED: the inline card's caption line (Figma: "City View, Balcony, Living Room, Kitchenette"). No upstream field today; hidden until sent.

view_type.description: PRD `view_type_tag`, optional and RESERVED (API GAP, OQ-03): the full screen room list's chip, e.g. "City view".

accessible.description: PRD `accessibility_badge`, optional and RESERVED (API GAP, OQ-03): true shows "Accessible room available". Upstream has only an "Accessible room upon request" line among some rooms' amenities, which stays in `amenity_groups`.

rate_plans.description: PRD `rate_plans[]` ← upstream `ratePlan[]`, FILTERED AND SORTED BY MULESOFT: only rates a user arriving from ChatGPT can book on the website (no test rates, no rates needing a member login while the MVP is anonymous; README, 'Which rates'), cheapest `per_night_rate` first. The inline card shows `rate_plans[0]` as "Our lowest price" and books it; the full screen's Rates tab lists them all.
